name: External Identity Provider Sign-In Success
summary: A returning user authenticates through a supported external identity provider, the validated provider identity is resolved to an existing durable user, and an authenticated application session is established.
finalOutcome: A validated external provider identity has been mapped to the existing durable user and an authenticated application session is active.

sourceReferences.note: Legacy journey provides discovery evidence and retains historical terminology until its own reconciliation.

Provider-specific sign-in such as Google, Microsoft, or Apple belongs beneath one External Identity Provider behavior; OIDC/OAuth are implementation protocol concerns rather than separate user behaviors.
